connections.how: With the red armchair on your left and white bed on your right, walk forward across the blue-bordered rug toward the dollhouse and wooden dresser.
Turn right past the wooden dresser on your left and walk through the doorway in the tree wallpaper wall to reach the stair railing and skylight.
With the stair railing on your right, turn left and pass through the open white paneled door on your left to reach the wooden desk with chair.
Walk forward past the wooden desk with chair on your left toward the small recessed window and wooden bookshelf with file box, with the portable AC unit to your right.
Turn around and walk back out past the wooden desk with chair and through the white paneled door to face the stair railing and green wall.
Step through the doorway adjacent to the stair railing, passing the light wooden armoire on your left, and turn around to face the open-top wooden chest on your left.
Turn left from the open-top wooden chest and walk across the purple patterned rug toward the carved wooden bench and mirror above bench.
Walk past the carved wooden bench on your right, with the dark wooden trunk and gray-covered bed to your left, toward the large window with radiator.
With the large window with radiator on your right, walk forward and turn left along the dark low bookcase beside the gray-covered bed.
Turn around with the dark low bookcase on your left and face the carved wooden bench across the purple patterned rug.
Walk past the carved wooden bench and exit through the doorway between the open-top wooden chest on your left and light wooden armoire on your right to reach the stair railing.
Turn left at the stair railing and green wall, then walk down the steps toward the framed picture on yellow wall and checkered bench, turning left at the landing to face the narrow wooden shelves.

walk_summary: Start with the red armchair on the left and white bed on the right, walking across the blue-bordered rug toward the wooden dresser and tree wallpaper wall.
Turn right past the wooden dresser and exit through the doorway in the tree wallpaper wall to the stair railing beneath the skylight.
Turn left at the stair railing and enter through the open white paneled door to the wooden desk with chair.
Walk past the wooden desk with chair to the small recessed window, wooden bookshelf with file box, and portable AC unit.
Exit back out past the wooden desk with chair to the stair railing and green wall.
Enter the adjacent doorway past the light wooden armoire toward the gray-covered bed and purple patterned rug, then turn around to face the open-top wooden chest.
Turn left past the open-top wooden chest and walk around the carved wooden bench toward the gray-covered bed, dark wooden trunk, and large window with radiator.
Move past the large window with radiator to the dark low bookcase next to the gray-covered bed, then turn around to face the carved wooden bench across the purple patterned rug.
Walk out the doorway past the open-top wooden chest and light wooden armoire to the stair railing and green wall.
Turn left and walk down the stairs past the framed picture on yellow wall and checkered bench to the narrow wooden shelves.
